tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.when_the_wind: The earth delights to feel your bare feet, and the winds long to play with your hair.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.lullaby.maxim: In dreams I forget I am a guest, and snatch a moment of joy.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.fire_waltz.ma: The bear that ate garlic and mugwort became human.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.crimson_heart: Where the lover's blood fell, red tulips grew.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.autumn_serena: Before the gates of excellence, the gods have placed sweat.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.absolution.ma: The weak can never forgive; forgiveness is the attribute of the strong.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.rosy_stride.m: The girl born inside a tulip sailed the stream on its petal.
Pluck one - loves me; pluck another - loves me not.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.prussian_leap: Once you have tasted flight, you will forever walk the earth with your eyes turned skyward.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.may_kiss.maxi: I am the rose of Sharon, and the lily of the valleys.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.fleurs_du_mal: Some flowers bloom more brightly on graves than in gardens.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.breath_of_anc: To speak the name of the dead is to make them live again.
Spring has returned. The Earth is like a child that knows poems.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.tender_thorns: O my luve is like a red, red rose.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.coronation.ma: Gold is the sweat of the sun.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.voracious_urn: I care more about Drosera than the origin of all the species in the world.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.hanami_tale.m: Falling cherry blossoms, blossoms yet to fall - all shall fall.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.echo_of_the_e: The gods gave death to mankind, and kept life for themselves.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.vernal_awaken: When you plant a seed, believe in the whole spring.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.the_gaze.maxi: If you gaze long into an abyss, the abyss gazes also into you.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.as_you_wish.m: He who polishes the lamp is granted one wish.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.springtime_st: Wanderer, there is no road; the road is made by walking.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.fleeting_bloo: Do we truly live on earth? Not forever on earth, only a little while here.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.when_the_wind: Instantly clears all negative effects and grants Slow Falling.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.lullaby.desc: Hostiles within 7 blocks become drowsy; phantoms stop hunting.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.first_bloom.d: A meal in a cup; food restores +50% while it lasts, and a full belly grants Haste.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.the_unnoticed: Instantly clears all mob hostility toward you.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.crimson_heart: 20% of your melee damage returns as health.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.autumn_serena: Harvesting mature crops multiplies drops; nearby drops drift to you.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.absolution.de: Newly applied negative effects are blocked.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.rosy_stride.d: Walk, sprint and jump on water; sneak to sink.
A small random boon every 8 seconds.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.prussian_leap: Immune to fall damage while active.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.may_kiss.desc: Releases a poison cloud when struck.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.fleurs_du_mal: Nearby beings wither within 7 blocks; you are immune.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.breath_of_anc: Brush dirt-family blocks to excavate artifacts.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.the_sunward.d: Regenerates under the open day sky; glows at night.
Immune to freezing, powder snow, fire and lava.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.tender_thorns: Attackers take 50%-200% of their own damage back, plus Weakness.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.coronation.de: Grants Luck, villagers revere you, with gold particles.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.voracious_urn: Kills count as Looting +1 and have a 30% chance to double drops.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.echo_of_the_e: A killing blow is answered: blink away alive on one heart, deathless and fireproof for 12s.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.the_gaze.desc: All beings within 25 blocks glow; a straight stare pins them for 4s, then slows.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.as_you_wish.d: Grants one random level-II boon, or luck.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.springtime_st: Walking leaves flowers or carpet in your steps.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.fleeting_bloo: Grants Speed, Strength, Haste and Resistance at once.
tip.kaleidoscope_flora.teapot_scoop.not_: The teapot must be empty to scoop.
Only drinks can be scooped into the teapot.
